watched TV
got dressed
fed the cat
Which did Lee do first?

8:00 is the earliest time.

The clocks show when some friends went shopping Monday afternoon:


Ron
Lena
Who went shopping second?

Ron
Lena
Who went shopping second?

content.html:
Read the time on each clock:


4:00
Ron
3:00
Lena
4:00 is later than 3:00.


Ron went shopping second.
